note: Small campground in the Appalachian Mountains of Garrett County, family-owned since 1964 (Grace and Doc Shunk), 2 miles from New Germany State Park.  Its rustic, shady sites are mostly back-ins on gravel and may need levelling; an RV water-filling station and a wash sink stand outside the renovated, heated bathhouse.  The sewer disposal area doesn't accommodate modern RVs but takes a rolling portable tank, and New Germany State Park's dump station is less than 5 miles away.  The small Glamp Store is open around the clock, fiber Wi-Fi arrived in summer 2026, and cell service is limited.  A-frame and other cabins are rented, a new pavilion is coming, and political flags aren't allowed.  CAVEAT on the pin: three sources disagree by up to 1.7 km on where this sits (a US Census rooftop match on the operator's published address, RV Life's pin 680 m west and Campspot's coordinates 1.7 km west), and Esri imagery is unbroken canopy at all three, so the coordinate here is the address match rather than a confirmed loop.  Not to be confused with New Germany State Park Campground (id 63), the separate state-run campground nearby. --Claude
